newsitem.title: CANADA: Chretien does not expect higher Canada inflation.
newsitem.headline: Chretien does not expect higher Canada inflation.

text.p: Prime Minister Jean Chretien said on Wednesday he does not expect Canadian inflation to go up.
"We do not expect inflation to increase," he told the House of Commons in answer to a question about economic policy from the opposition Bloc Quebecois.
He said the Canadian economy was performing quite well and had created more jobs than Germany, France and Italy combined.
Chretien declared Canada had solved the problem of fiscal deficits that he had inherited.
